'''Pirate dropships''', also referred to as '''ships''' for brevity,<ref name="SC 108 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> were a type of open-topped, [[cannon]]ed [[repulsorcraft]] utilized by [[pirate]]s during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 108" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> dropships were used by [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]'s [[Silvo's pirates|pirate gang]] during the [[Invasion of At Attin]]. Upon landing, several drop teams began rounding up the [[planet]]'s townsfolk, whereas a few others remained airborne to shell disobedient [[At Attin]] residents from above the ground. With the arrival of a [[New Republic]] [[squadron]], however, the drop teams retreated, heading for their [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]], which shortly crashed under the impact of aerial fire.<ref name="SC 108" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Pirate]] [[dropship]]s first appeared in the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', making their debut in the finale episode "[[The Real Good Guys]],"<ref name="SC 108" /> which was aired on [[January 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> The name of the [[repulsorcraft]] utilized by [[Silvo's pirates]] was specified in the [[Disney+]] audio description of the episode, narrated by [[Jedediah Barton]].<ref name="SC 108 AD" />
